description: Land Acquisition - Balakaduwa, Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose, including location, boundaries, owners, and extent. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
